rules.condition_template_help: Optional. The template must return true in addition to the comparison. All Home Assistant Jinja functions and entities are available. Additional variables: entity_id, state and value.
rules.condition_template_only_help: Required. The template must return true to trigger the alert; no other comparison is evaluated. All Home Assistant Jinja functions and entities are available. Additional variables: entity_id, state and value.
rules.condition_template_unchanged_help: Optional. The template must return true in addition to the state and attributes remaining unchanged. All Home Assistant Jinja functions and entities are available. Additional variables: entity_id, state and value.
rules.condition_template_required: The Jinja condition is required when the source is “Jinja”.

rules.message_help: Supports Jinja. All Home Assistant Jinja functions and entities are available. Additional variables: entity_id, state and value. The rendered message is frozen when the alert becomes active.
rules.multiple_any: The alert triggers as soon as one value matches.
rules.multiple_none: The alert triggers only when none of the values match.
rules.name: Name
rules.title: Custom rules
rules.yaml_help: With a state or attribute source, the Alert Manager comparison is required and condition_template remains optional. With source: unchanged, the state and attributes are monitored for changes and condition_template remains optional. With the Jinja source (source: none), only condition_template is evaluated and it is required. Automation and, or and not groups are not supported.
